Charles Owen YR8 Riding Hat

# META TITLE
Charles Owen YR8 Riding Hat | Discount Equestrian

# META DESCRIPTION
The standard Charles Owen YR8 is a peaked riding hat for young riders, trimmed in microfibre suede and certified to PAS 015: 2011 with the BSI Kitemark.

# SHORT DESCRIPTION
The Charles Owen YR8 is a [riding hat](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/rider/riding-wear/riding-hats.html) designed for young riders, suited to everyday riding, competitions and schooling sessions. This is the standard YR8, rather than the YR8 Sparkly.

- **Type:** peaked riding hat from the Charles Owen kids helmet range, made specifically for young riders.
- **Protection:** PAS 015: 2011 with the BSI Kitemark, plus VG1 01.040 2014-12, giving the hat certification to both British and European specifications.
- **Secure fit:** adjustable nylon harness, letting you set the hat to sit firmly on your child's head.
- **Comfort:** four discreet ventilation holes, adding airflow for more comfortable rides.
- **Style:** full microfibre suede trim, giving a smart, sophisticated look.

See Safety standards & construction, Sizing & fit and Comfort features below for the full details, or read our guide to [riding hat safety standards](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/blog/riding-hat-safety-standards-pas-015-en1384-vg1-astm-and-snell-explained.html) to see what each standard covers.

# LONG DESCRIPTION
## Safety standards & construction
### Safety standards & certification
- **PAS 015: 2011:** The British specification for riding helmets, developed by the British Standards Institution (BSI). It covers flat and hazard edge impact, penetration and crush resistance, along with harness retention and stability.
- **VG1 01.040 2014-12:** A European interim specification introduced in 2014, now being progressively replaced by BS EN 1384:2023.
- **BSI Kitemark (KM 669253):** BSI audits production on an ongoing basis. One hat from every batch of 800 to 3,200 is tested independently, and any batch that fails is destroyed.

## Riding use
**Competition suitability:** With PAS 015: 2011 and the BSI Kitemark, the YR8 meets the hat standards accepted by British Eventing, The Pony Club, British Riding Clubs, BHS activities and British Showjumping.

## Sizing & fit
**Size:** Available in sizes 6⅜ to 6⅝ (52 to 54cm), plus 7¼ (59cm) in a round fit, all of them [children's sizes](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/rider/riding-wear/riding-hats/childrens-riding-hats.html).

**Fit system:** Adjust the nylon harness while your child is wearing the hat, tightening it until the hat sits firmly and moves as little as possible from front to back and side to side.

**Fit guidance:** Measure around the widest part of your child's head, over their hair, with a soft fabric tape: about a finger's width above the eyebrows, just above the ears and around the bump at the back. Repeat the measurement in centimetres a couple of times, round up if it falls between two sizes, then check the size chart. Never choose a size up for growing room. The hat should feel snug with even pressure all round, and should not rock forwards or backwards with the harness undone.

## Comfort features
**Ventilation:** The four ventilation holes are placed at the front and rear of the hat to keep air moving. This helps young riders stay cool and comfortable through long sessions and in warm weather.

## Design details
**Finish:** The microfibre suede trim is soft to the touch and gives a durable surface that is easy to look after.

**Colour:** Black, Black - Charcoal and Navy.

## Care & maintenance
**Post-impact replacement & lifespan:** Replace the YR8 after any impact, even when no damage is visible, and expect it to last three to five years with normal use.

## About the brand
Owned by the same family for four generations, [Charles Owen](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/shop-by-brand/charles-owen.html) is now run by the founder's great-grandson. In 1983 it created the first dual-standard riding helmet and was awarded the Royal Warrant as protective headgear supplier to the Royal Mews at Buckingham Palace. Today it stands among Britain's leading riding helmet makers, with more than 115 years of history.

Charles Owen riding hats are stocked at [discount-equestrian.co.uk](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/), a UK equestrian retailer with 14 years' experience in horse riding clothes and horse supplies, and riding hats are among our most important products. We serve first-time riders to professional yards, with a free fitting for adults and children on every hat bought in store, plus free UK delivery over £45.
